content:
:::passage[Cerita Fabel: The Lion and the Mouse (Soal No. 1 – 5)]
*Read the short story below thoroughly to answer numbers 1 to 5!*

“A lion was awakened from sleep by a mouse running over his face. Rising up with anger, he caught the mouse and was about to kill him. Then, the mouse interrupted saying, ‘If you would only spare my life, I would be sure to repay your kindness.’ The lion laughed and let him go.
It happened shortly after this that the lion was caught by some hunters, who bound him by strong ropes to the ground. The mouse, recognizing the lion's roar, came and gnawed the rope with his teeth, and set him free!
The mouse then told the lion, ‘You ridiculed the idea that I would ever be able to help you. You didn't expect to receive from me any repayment of your favor. Now you know that it is possible for even a mouse to help out a lion.’”
:::

Who interrupted the lion’s sleep?
explanation:
Teks: *“A lion was awakened from sleep by a mouse running over his face.”* Yang mengganggu tidur singa adalah seekor tikus.

Kunci Jawaban: **D**

content:
Mother : “Shouldn’t you … your sandwich?”
Anne : “I’m still full, Mom.”
explanation: Sandwich adalah makanan padat, sehingga kata kerja yang sesuai adalah memakan (*eat*).

content:
:::passage[Percakapan Liburan (Soal No. 8 – 10)]
*Read the text to answer questions 8 – 10!*

**Mei-mei :** “Hi, Nana! Where did you go for the holiday?”
**Nana :** “Oh, I had my holiday at my aunt’s house near Ontario Lake! How about your holiday? Where did you go?”
**Mei-mei :** “My grandparents who live in Shanghai invited me for their anniversary celebration, so my parents and I all went there! It was so much fun.”
**Nana :** “I guess we all enjoyed our holiday!”
:::

Where did Mei-mei have her holiday?
explanation: Mei-mei berkata kakek-neneknya yang tinggal di Shanghai mengundangnya, *"so my parents and I all went there!"* Jadi Mei-mei berlibur di Shanghai.

content: Dennisa has a cat. She loves … cat so much.
explanation: Dennisa adalah nama perempuan (*She*), maka kata ganti kepemilikannya adalah *her* (*her cat*).

content: You use your … to write something.
explanation: Bagian tubuh untuk menulis adalah tangan (*hand*).

content: Which of the following is an item of clothing that is worn on the head?
explanation: Benda pakaian penutup kepala adalah topi (*hat*).

content: Arrange the jumbled letters into the correct color name: U - R - P - P - L - E
explanation: Susunan huruf U-R-P-P-L-E membentuk kata warna ungu yaitu *P-U-R-P-L-E* (Purple).

content: What is a common pet for people to have in their homes?
explanation: Hewan peliharaan (*pet*) yang umum dipelihara di rumah (di akuarium) adalah ikan (*fish*). Gajah, jerapah, dan singa adalah satwa liar.

content: Rearrange the words into a correct sentence: An - it - apple - is
explanation: Pola kalimat pernyataan deklaratif bahasa Inggris: Subjek (*It*) + to be (*is*) + Objek (*an apple*) $\rightarrow$ *"It is an apple"*.

content: Fish live in an aquarium. Fish can …?
explanation: Kemampuan bergerak alami ikan di dalam air adalah berenang (*swim*).

content: The … eats grass.
explanation: Hewan herbivora pemakan rumput (*eats grass*) adalah sapi (*cow*). Singa dan kucing adalah karnivora.

content: The toothpaste and toothbrush are kept in the …?
explanation: Pasta gigi dan sikat gigi disimpan di kamar mandi (*bathroom*).

content: N - R - D - A - G - E. The correct word arrangement is …?
explanation: Huruf N-R-D-A-G-E disusun menjadi kata kebun/taman yaitu *G-A-R-D-E-N*.

content:

B : “Yes, it is. It’s … the branch.”
explanation: Burung yang bertengger menempel di atas dahan pohon menggunakan preposisi *on* (*on the branch*).

explanation: Anak kucing yang berada di dalam kardus menggunakan preposisi *inside* / *in* (*inside the box*).

content: The dog is sleeping … the desk.
explanation: Gambar stimulus menunjukkan anjing tidur di kolong/bawah meja (*under the desk*).

content: The cat is sleeping … the boy.
explanation: Gambar stimulus memperlihatkan kucing berbaring di samping/sebelah anak laki-laki (*beside the boy*).

content: “Oh no! The cat is … Dad’s table!”
explanation: Gambar stimulus menampilkan kucing yang melompat dan berdiri di atas permukaan meja (*on top of the table*).

content:
:::passage[Teks Cerita: Florida Beach (Soal No. 26 – 30)]
*Read the text to answer numbers 26 - 30!*

Every year we go to Florida. We like to go to the beach.
My favorite beach is called Emerson Beach. It is very long, with soft sand and palm trees. It is very beautiful. I like to make sandcastles and watch the sailboats go by. Sometimes there are dolphins and whales in the water!
Every morning, we look for shells in the sand. I found fifteen big shells last year. I put them in a special place in my room. This year I want to learn to surf. It is hard to surf, but so much fun! My sister is a good surfer. She says that she can teach me. I hope I can do it!
:::

Where do I go every year for a vacation?
explanation:
Kalimat pertama: *“Every year we go to Florida.”*

Kunci Jawaban: **C**

content:
:::passage[Dialog (Soal No. 33 – 34)]
*The following dialog is for questions number 33 and 34:*

**Anisa :** “Hi Billy, what are you eating?”
**Billy :** “A few slices of melon. My mom prepared them in my lunch box.”
**Anisa :** “Do you like melons?”
**Billy :** “Not really, I prefer watermelon. It is juicier.”
:::

What does Billy have in his lunch box?
explanation: Billy berkata: *"A few slices of melon. My mom prepared them in my lunch box."* Jadi isinya beberapa potong melon (*some melon cuts*).

:::passage[Teks Perkenalan (Soal No. 38 – 39)]
*The following text is for questions number 38 and 39:*

“Hello, my name is Helena Binawan. I live in Bandung, West Java. I am the youngest in my family. My oldest brother is Irgy Binawan. He is 14 years old and studies in SMP Bina Bangsa. My older brother is Jeremy Binawan. He is 10 years old. He studies in SD Bina Bangsa. I am the only girl in my family.”
:::

How many children does the Binawan family have?
explanation:
Keluarga Binawan punya tiga anak: Irgy (laki-laki), Jeremy (laki-laki), dan Helena (*the only girl*).

Kunci Jawaban: **B**

options.content: Three children, two boys and one girl.

content:
:::passage[Teks Perkenalan (Soal No. 38 – 39)]
*The following text is for questions number 38 and 39:*

“Hello, my name is Helena Binawan. I live in Bandung, West Java. I am the youngest in my family. My oldest brother is Irgy Binawan. He is 14 years old and studies in SMP Bina Bangsa. My older brother is Jeremy Binawan. He is 10 years old. He studies in SD Bina Bangsa. I am the only girl in my family.”
:::

How old is most probably Helena?
explanation:
Helena adalah anak bungsu, sedangkan kakaknya Jeremy berumur 10 tahun. Jadi umur Helena kurang dari 10 tahun; pilihan yang mungkin hanya 8 tahun.

Kunci Jawaban: **D**

content: What do I call my mother’s brother?
explanation: Saudara laki-laki dari ibu adalah paman (*uncle*).
